description: This file defines the Coroutine class which implements promise-based asynchronous control flow using generator functions in PHP. It provides mechanisms to create, manage, and resolve promises via coroutines, facilitating sequential async operations in a style similar to async/await in other languages.

classes.name: Coroutine
classes.description: A class that creates and manages promises based on generator functions, allowing asynchronous code to execute in a linear, generator-driven manner.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new Coroutine instance wrapping a generator function.

methods.name: then
methods.description: Registers callbacks to be invoked upon the promise's fulfillment or rejection.

methods.name: otherwise
methods.description: Registers a callback to be invoked upon promise rejection.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Blocks and waits for the promise to settle, optionally unwrapping the value.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current state of the promise (e.g., pending, fulfilled, rejected).

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves the promise with a given value.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Rejects the promise with a specified reason.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels the current promise and the overall coroutine.

methods.name: nextCoroutine
methods.description: Advances the generator to the next step, associating the yielded promise.

methods.name: _handleSuccess
methods.description: Handles successful resolution of the yielded promise, sending the value back into the generator.

methods.name: _handleFailure
methods.description: Handles failure or rejection of the yielded promise, throwing an exception into the generator.
